title: Identify the top three most frequently occurring visual frame effects among
question: Identify the top three most frequently occurring visual frame effects among cards that are either banned or restricted in any format, have at least one ruling (regardless of content), and belong to sets that include Italian translations. Exclude cards with NULL frame effects.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_018 AS frame_effect, COUNT(*) AS frequency
FROM cards c
WHERE c.XCL_018 IS NOT NULL
  AND c.XCL_072 IN (
    SELECT l.XCL_086
    FROM legalities l
    WHERE l.XCL_085 IN ('Banned', 'Restricted')
  )
  AND c.XCL_072 IN (
    SELECT r.XCL_090
    FROM rulings r
  )
  AND c.XCL_063 IN (
    SELECT st.XCL_093
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.XCL_092 = 'Italian'
  )
GROUP BY c.XCL_018
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 3
